# T004 — Pin and verify Node 24

## Summary

Pinned the root npm workspace and both applications to Node 24.x. Verified the changes using the preinstalled Node v24.21.0 and its bundled npm 11.19.0. **Checkpoint environment still needs selection:** unmodified runner `PATH` starts with `/opt/node/22/bin`, so an unconfigured checkpoint runs Node v22.23.3, not 24. Agent-local `PATH` selection does not persist into the checkpoint process. Do not mark the Node 24 checkpoint verified until its runner selects `/opt/node/24/bin` ahead of Node 22.

## Changes

- `.nvmrc`: select major line 24.
- `package.json`, `frontend/package.json`, `backend/package.json`: restrict engines to `>=24.0.0 <25.0.0`.
- `package-lock.json`, `backend/package-lock.json`: regenerated with npm 11 on Node 24 (`npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund` at root and with `--prefix backend`). LockfileVersion remains 3; npm pruned stale optional peer entries in the root lock and updated workspace metadata, with no manual lockfile edits.
- `README.md`: replace Node 22 references and document the Node 24/npm 11 local and deployment prerequisites; no tracked CI or Docker runtime exists.

## Decisions

- [Official Node release schedule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/Release/main/schedule.json), checked 2026-10-10: Node 24 is LTS through 2028-04-30; Node 26 does not enter LTS until 2026-10-28. Current 22 support ends 2027-04-30. [Node 23 notable changes](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v23.0.0) include default `require(esm)` and test-runner improvements. [Node 24 notable changes](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.0.0) include V8 13.6, npm 11, `AsyncContextFrame` as the AsyncLocalStorage default, global `URLPattern`, test-runner subtest waiting, Undici 7 and runtime deprecations of `url.parse()`/`SlowBuffer`. No runtime warnings appeared with `--trace-deprecation` on the offline startup/health smoke. Existing ESM backend and frontend characterize behavior; no source or TypeScript changes needed.
- The standalone backend has no Azure credentials in the environment; its service cannot boot with *all* TTS credentials empty (pre-existing initialization error). The offline HTTP smoke uses `AZURE_TTS_KEY=offline-test-only`, `AZURE_TTS_REGION=westus`, no ACS credentials and no service calls, matching the T002 route-test fixture. `/health` returned 200 with ACS unconfigured and connectivity false. Live ACS/Blob/Speech not verified.
- No repo-supported mechanism can change the checkpoint runner's inherited `PATH`; changing `/opt/node/22/bin` or its launcher's configuration would be outside task path scope. Select Node 24 in the checkpoint environment before running its gates, rather than relying on `.nvmrc` being loaded automatically.

## Validation

Node v24.21.0 / npm 11.19.0, Linux, using `PATH=/opt/node/24/bin:$PATH` per validation process; default unchanged shell runs Node v22.23.3. Standalone `npm ci --prefix backend --no-audit --no-fund` passed. Exact root gates in order: `npm ci` passed (926 installed); `npm run build --if-present` passed; `TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm test` passed; `npm run lint --if-present` passed; `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json` passed. No build errors; three existing CSS optimizer warnings and five existing lint warnings. JUnit reports in ignored `.modernization-scratch/T004-{backend,frontend}.xml`: backend 10 and frontend 25, total **35 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**, unchanged from T003. Offline backend startup and `/health` passed with test-only TTS placeholders and `--trace-deprecation`.

## Follow-ups and risks

- **Blocker for automatic completion:** select `/opt/node/24/bin` in the checkpoint gate runner's default environment; otherwise its exact commands will execute on 22 and cannot establish Node 24 validity. No system-level files modified.
- Follow-up investigation: `get_run_state` exposes the approved validation commands but no runtime selector; the documented `complete_task` parameters are only task key, status, summary and modified files, with no environment or Node-version override. `.futuristic` contains only gate/output directories and no tracked runner configuration. The shell defaults to `/opt/node/22/bin/node` (v22.23.3); Node 24 is installed at `/opt/node/24/bin`, but `nvm`, `fnm`, `volta` and `mise` are unavailable. `.nvmrc` and `engines.node` declare the target; neither automatically changes the checkpoint process's inherited PATH. An agent-local PATH prefix only affects that shell process, not `complete_task`. Owner/operator action required: configure the checkpoint gate runner to launch with `/opt/node/24/bin` preceding `/opt/node/22/bin` in PATH, or provide a documented per-run Node 24 runtime selector, then confirm the checkpoint executes `node --version` as 24 before its unchanged gates. Do not edit `/opt/node` or validation scripts to simulate selection.
- npm 11 `npm ci` reports four existing deprecated packages, 56 vulnerable entries and three install scripts not approved by its new install-scripts policy; build and tests nevertheless pass. Advisory remediation belongs to T005–T008; do not use `npm audit fix --force`. Deployment runtime has no tracked pin beyond docs/engines/.nvmrc; confirm actual hosting runtime before deployment.
